description:
Routing probes for all 25 acs skills. 23 are model-invocable and get one natural-language request that must route to them without naming them. The 2 user-only skills (disable-model-invocation:true) get a pair each: an explicit invocation that MUST route, and a bare description of their intent that must NOT.

This file is the curated data. runner/gen_plugin_eval.py renders it into evals/**/case.yaml for `claude plugin eval`; dataset/cases/10-skills.json pins the routing SURFACE (each skill's shipped description and invocation flag) deterministically, with no model.
